targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  p.id,
  p.name,
  p.category,
  p.subcategory,
  p.source,
  p.source_id,
  p.region,
  ST_X(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lng,
  ST_Y(ST_Centroid(p.geom)) AS lat,
  count(DISTINCT r.id) AS reservable_count,
  max(s.observed_at) AS latest_availability_observed_at
FROM pois p
JOIN reservable_pois rp ON rp.poi_id = p.id
JOIN reservables r ON r.id = rp.reservable_id
LEFT JOIN availability_snapshot s ON s.reservable_id = r.id
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND (${poi_name_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%')
  AND CASE
    WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} = '' THEN true
    WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN p.id::text = ${poi_id_search:sqlstring}
    ELSE false
  END
  AND (${poi_category:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.category IN (${poi_category:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY p.id
ORDER BY reservable_count DESC, p.name ASC, p.id ASC
LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  p.id AS poi_id,
  p.name,
  p.category,
  p.subcategory,
  p.source,
  p.source_id,
  p.region,
  count(DISTINCT r.id) AS reservable_count,
  count(DISTINCT r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.type = 'site') AS site_count,
  max(r.updated_at) AS latest_catalog_updated_at,
  max(s.observed_at) AS latest_availability_observed_at,
  bool_or(s.available) FILTER (WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS any_available_last_7d
FROM pois p
JOIN reservable_pois rp ON rp.poi_id = p.id
JOIN reservables r ON r.id = rp.reservable_id
LEFT JOIN availability_snapshot s ON s.reservable_id = r.id
WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND (${poi_name_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%')
  AND CASE
    WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} = '' THEN true
    WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN p.id::text = ${poi_id_search:sqlstring}
    ELSE false
  END
  AND (${poi_category:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.category IN (${poi_category:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY p.id
ORDER BY reservable_count DESC, p.name ASC, p.id ASC
LIMIT 500;

SELECT
  p.id AS poi_id,
  p.name,
  p.category,
  p.subcategory,
  p.source,
  p.source_id,
  p.region,
  p.reserve_url,
  p.info_url,
  p.provider_ref,
  count(DISTINCT r.id) AS reservable_count,
  max(s.observed_at) AS latest_availability_observed_at,
  now() - max(s.observed_at) AS latest_availability_age,
  bool_or(s.available) FILTER (WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS any_available_last_7d
FROM pois p
JOIN reservable_pois rp ON rp.poi_id = p.id
JOIN reservables r ON r.id = rp.reservable_id
LEFT JOIN availability_snapshot s ON s.reservable_id = r.id
WHERE ${poi_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND p.id::text = ${poi_id:sqlstring}
  AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY p.id;

SELECT
  r.id AS reservable_id,
  r.type || ':' || r.vendor || ':' || r.vendor_id AS rid,
  r.type,
  r.vendor,
  r.vendor_id,
  r.name,
  r.loop,
  r.site_type,
  r.source,
  r.updated_at,
  max(s.observed_at) AS latest_availability_observed_at,
  count(s.id) FILTER (WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS snapshots_last_7d,
  bool_or(s.available) FILTER (WHERE s.observed_at >= now() - interval '7 days') AS any_available_last_7d,
  r.provider_ref,
  r.tags,
  r.raw
FROM reservable_pois rp
JOIN reservables r ON r.id = rp.reservable_id
LEFT JOIN availability_snapshot s ON s.reservable_id = r.id
WHERE ${poi_id:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$'
  AND rp.poi_id::text = ${poi_id:sqlstring}
  AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND (${rid_type:sqlstring} = '' OR r.type = ${rid_type:sqlstring})
GROUP BY r.id
ORDER BY r.loop NULLS LAST, r.name NULLS LAST, rid ASC;

list.name: poi_category
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT p.category AS __text, p.category AS __value FROM pois p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservable_pois rp JOIN reservables r ON r.id = rp.reservable_id WHERE rp.poi_id = p.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL) ORDER BY p.category ASC

list.name: poi_id
list.query: WITH matches AS (SELECT p.id::text || ' - ' || p.name || ' [' || p.category || ']' AS __text, p.id::text AS __value, p.name, p.id FROM pois p WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reservable_pois rp JOIN reservables r ON r.id = rp.reservable_id WHERE rp.poi_id = p.id AND r.deleted_at IS NULL) AND (${poi_name_search:sqlstring} = '' OR p.name ILIKE '%' || ${poi_name_search:sqlstring} || '%') AND CASE WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} = '' THEN true WHEN ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN p.id::text = ${poi_id_search:sqlstring} ELSE false END AND (${poi_category:sqlstring} IN ('', '__all') OR p.category IN (${poi_category:sqlstring})) ORDER BY p.name ASC, p.id ASC LIMIT 500) SELECT __text, __value FROM matches UNION ALL SELECT 'No matching POI' AS __text, '__none' AS __value WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM matches)
